# Analysis results (generated by `method/analysis.py`; validation + train-CV only, test split never read)

Protocol. Val-hard = 355 validation groups with >=2 distinct valid answers (1 group = 0.28 pt; Wilson 95% CI on a single accuracy is about +-4.5 pt, so differences below ~3 pt are not resolvable on val alone). CV-hard = pooled accuracy on the 2114 hard train groups, 5 group-folds (seed 0), models trained on the other folds only (early-stopping holdout inside the training pool); fold-to-fold sd is 1.5-2.5 pt, pooled-CV standard error ~0.9 pt. Exp 1-3 re-train single NNs (DeepSets unless stated; H=128, same hyper-parameters as the final model, hard-train only): val = mean+-sd over 3 seeds (0-2), CV = mean over 2 seeds (0,1) (seed sd ~0.2-0.5 pt). "sum" = answer-cluster-sum decode, "arg" = plain argmax of candidate score. Feature ablations zero the dropped input columns (and their group-demeaned copies); "emb none" removes the 1024-d embedding branch. Final-model rows (exp 4-6) use the frozen K=5 ensemble.

| vote only | 67.9±0.0 | [62.9, 72.5] | 66.6 |

| + reasoning content | 77.9±0.5 | [73.4, 82.0] | 75.2 |
| + embeddings (= final arch) | 83.6±0.4 | [79.5, 87.1] | 79.8 |
| embeddings + vote only | 79.7±0.0 | [75.2, 83.6] | 77.5 |
| embeddings only (no hand, no vote) | 79.2±0.4 | [74.6, 83.1] | 77.1 |
| full - answer-level | 79.8±0.6 | [75.2, 83.6] | 78.4 |
| full - surface/format | 82.3±0.8 | [77.9, 85.9] | 80.1 |
| full - reasoning content | 83.1±0.4 | [78.9, 86.6] | 78.5 |

Baselines: vote tie->longest val-hard 70.7 (CI [65.8, 75.2]), final K=5 ensemble 84.8. 1a uses cluster-sum decode on vote features only: ties are broken by index, hence below the tie->longest heuristic.

Rows 1h-1j drop one group from the full model (leave-one-group-out). Groups: vote = cnt/share/ndist/is_top/ntop; answer-level = parse validity, is_int, negative, magnitude, rank among answers, answer-is-a-question-number; surface/format = length (7 feats), boxed/####/placeholder, truncation, #lines, "final answer" count, hedging words; reasoning content = arithmetic-check counts/fraction, question-number coverage, answer repeated in body, cluster-level arithmetic stats.

| config | val-hard sum | CI | CV-hard sum | val-hard arg | CV-hard arg |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| full (ref) | 83.6±0.4 | [79.5, 87.1] | 79.8 | 83.2±0.4 | 79.0 |
| full - length/format feats | 82.4±0.9 | [78.2, 86.1] | 80.0 | 82.6±0.8 | 79.7 |
| no-emb hand - length/format | 74.7±0.5 | [69.9, 78.9] | 73.8 | 73.1±1.1 | 70.8 |
| vote+emb raw | 79.7±0.0 | [75.2, 83.6] | 77.5 | 79.9±0.9 | 78.2 |
| vote+emb length-residualized (emb R2 on len/fmt = 0.055) | 77.8±0.3 | [73.1, 81.8] | 76.3 | 77.9±0.6 | 77.1 |
| emb only raw | 79.2±0.4 | [74.6, 83.1] | 77.1 | 78.1±0.5 | 74.8 |
| emb only length-residualized (emb R2 on len/fmt = 0.055) | 79.2±1.1 | [74.6, 83.1] | 76.2 | 75.9±1.5 | 73.5 |
| full hand + resid emb (emb R2 on len/fmt = 0.055) | 83.1±0.7 | [78.9, 86.6] | 79.3 | 82.9±0.9 | 78.6 |
| full - length/format + resid emb (emb R2 on len/fmt = 0.055) | 83.0±0.4 | [78.9, 86.6] | 79.1 | 82.9±0.1 | 78.7 |

Length/format features = log-length, relative length/rank, longest/shortest flags, cluster mean length, boxed/####/placeholder/agree flags, "final answer" count, tail length, truncation, #lines, repeated-line fraction. Residualization: standardized embedding minus its least-squares fit on [1, log-len, log-len^2, boxed, ####, placeholder, truncated, #lines] (fit on training candidates only).

## Exp 3. Cross-candidate comparison

| model | feature set | val-hard sum | val-hard arg | CV-hard sum | CV-hard arg |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| none | full | 83.6±0.3 | 83.6±0.4 | 79.6 | 79.0 |
| none | no vote/cluster feats | 83.0±1.2 | 82.5±2.0 | 79.2 | 78.4 |
| none | no cross-cand info | 83.6±0.6 | 83.1±0.5 | 80.0 | 78.7 |
| deepsets | full | 83.6±0.4 | 83.2±0.4 | 79.8 | 79.0 |
| deepsets | no vote/cluster feats | 83.8±0.3 | 82.3±0.5 | 79.4 | 78.0 |
| deepsets | no cross-cand info | 83.3±0.1 | 82.7±0.6 | 79.8 | 78.3 |

"no vote/cluster feats": drops vote counts/share/ndist/top flags, cluster-level stats, same-answer cosine similarity and count. "no cross-cand info": additionally drops every group-demeaned (relative) feature, relative length/rank/magnitude flags, rank among answers and all cosine features, so the "none" network scores each candidate strictly on its own (argmax decode). Prior results (results_nn.md, 3 seeds, val-hard): none 83.57+-0.27, DeepSets 83.57+-0.35, attention 82.16+-1.5.

## Exp 4. Uncertainty of the final K=5 ensemble

Confidence = probability mass of the chosen answer cluster (sum of member-averaged candidate probabilities of the traces giving that answer). Val-hard: n=355, accuracy 84.8, mean confidence 82.5, ECE (10 bins) 0.039, Brier 0.111. Out-of-fold train-CV (5 seeds averaged, 2114 hard groups): accuracy 80.5, mean confidence 80.7, ECE 0.016.

| coverage (most confident first) | 30% | 50% | 70% | 80% | 90% | 100% |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| val-hard selective acc | 100.0 | 96.1 | 93.2 | 90.5 | 87.2 | 84.8 |
| CV-hard selective acc | 97.6 | 94.9 | 90.2 | 87.6 | 84.1 | 80.5 |

| margin (top - 2nd cluster mass) | n (val-hard) | accuracy |
|---|---|---|
| [0.0, 0.1) | 22 | 59.1 |
| [0.1, 0.3) | 46 | 63.0 |
| [0.3, 0.5) | 36 | 75.0 |
| [0.5, 0.7) | 44 | 79.5 |
| [0.7, 0.9) | 77 | 87.0 |
| [0.9, 1.0) | 130 | 100.0 |

Agreement of final NN / LR / vote on val-hard (by chosen answer):

| pattern | n | final acc | LR acc | vote acc |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| all agree | 269 | 88.1 | 88.1 | 88.1 |
| final=LR != vote | 55 | 74.5 | 74.5 | 12.7 |
| LR=vote != final | 24 | 83.3 | 16.7 | 16.7 |
| all differ | 2 | 0.0 | 100.0 | 0.0 |
| final=vote != LR | 5 | 60.0 | 0.0 | 60.0 |

Final accuracy: 88.1 on the 269 groups where all three agree vs 74.4 on the 86 groups with any disagreement.

## Exp 5. Compute vs accuracy

Inference wall = fresh `predict.py` + `score_predictions.py` processes on validation (all 1319 groups), OMP/OPENBLAS/MKL threads=4, median of 3 runs, this 2-core machine. CV-hard for vote = accuracy on all train-hard groups (no fitting).

| method | val-all | val-hard [95% CI] | CV-hard | wall s | assets |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| majority vote (tie->longest) | 86.97 | 70.7 [65.8, 75.2] | 69.9 | 0.38 | 0 KiB |
| LR (hand+cross+PCA64) | 91.10 | 80.0 [75.5, 83.8] | 77.3 | 1.07 | 269 KiB |
| DeepSets NN K=1 | 92.73 | 83.7 [79.5, 87.1] | 80.0 | 1.11 | 885 KiB |
| DeepSets NN K=3 | 93.48 | 85.4 [81.3, 88.7] | 80.2 | 1.24 | 2655 KiB |
| DeepSets NN K=5 (final) | 93.23 | 84.8 [80.7, 88.2] | 80.4 | 1.38 | 4424 KiB |

Training cost (this machine): hand+cross features, train 4.5k groups (s): 4.0; LR PCA+design+fit (s): 1.5; NN sec per member (s, incl. early stop): 4.9; NN K=5 train (s) = 5 x member: 24.7.
Existing K-curve (CV-hard / wall): K=1 79.96 / 1.11 s, K=3 80.24 / 1.24, K=5 80.45 / 1.35, K=10 80.45 / 1.68 (results_final.md); gains beyond K~5 are inside noise.

## Exp 6. Failure analysis (final model, val-hard, 54 errors of 355)

Automatic categories over all errors (by vote structure of the 4 candidates):

| category | errors |
|---|---|
| plurality answer wrong | 27 |
| all answers distinct | 14 |
| 2-2 tie lost | 6 |
| picked non-plurality answer | 4 |
| overrode correct plurality | 3 |

Vote pattern of errors (answer counts): 2-1-1: 19, 3-1: 13, 2-2: 6, 1-1-1: 6, 1-1-1-1: 5, 1-1: 3, 2-1: 2. Errors in groups with >=1 unparseable trace: 11; an unparseable trace that visibly contains the gold answer: 4.

Accuracy by vote pattern on all val-hard groups (right/n): 3-1: 138/151, 2-1-1: 69/88, 2-2: 28/34, 2-1: 26/28, 1-1-1-1: 15/20, 1-1-1: 14/20, 1-1: 11/14.

Manual reading of 20 errors (first 20 of every-second-error in bank order, i.e. a systematic sample; cause judged from the question and the 4 traces):

| cause | n | groups |
|---|---|---|
| shared misreading (wrong cluster >=2 traces) | 9 | 44, 52, 81, 318, 328, 331, 497, 586, 617 |
| no vote signal, hard problem (all answers distinct) | 5 | 133, 210, 338, 397, 550 |
| coin-flip 2-2 tie | 2 | 9, 362 |
| correct trace lost to format (unparseable / near-tie) | 2 | 240, 444 |
| confident singleton overrides correct plurality | 2 | 111, 203 |

Illustrative excerpts (last lines of the trace):

- group 444: correct answer 40 only in traces that end without ####/boxed (unparseable); chosen 45 at p=0.94.
  - trace 0: `$$ 100 + x = 140 $$ / $$ x = 40 $$ / ### ✅ Final Answer: **40 meters**.`
  - trace 1: `x = \frac{90}{2} = 45 / ### Final Answer: / \boxed{45}`
- group 586: three traces share the misreading (all 250-70); the single correct trace (40) gets p=0.06.
  - trace 2: `\text{Absent students} = 250 - 70 = 180 / ### ✅ Final Answer: / \boxed{180}`
  - trace 3: `250 - 140 - 70 = 40 / ### Final Answer: / \boxed{40}`
